title: Which Southeast Asian country will declare a state of emergency over wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026?
background: Seasonal wildfire smoke can cross borders in Southeast Asia, creating public-health risks and prompting emergency government responses.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official national government announcements, corroborated by reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the country whose national authorities announce a formal state of emergency because of wildfire haze between September 1 and September 5, 2026, inclusive. The declaration may cover the entire country or a specific area within it. Air-quality warnings, school closures, or health advisories without a formal emergency declaration do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country’s common English name.
